issue.title: Add Expo Doctor to Dependabot workflow and CI
issue.body:
## Summary

Dependabot/npm bumps can drift Expo SDK–aligned packages and duplicate native modules without failing lint or unit tests. We need `expo-doctor` in CI and in the Dependabot agent workflow, plus agent rules that never push to `main` and ignore org umbrella rules.

## Scope

- Add `npm run doctor` (`expo-doctor`) and run it in Test Check CI after `npm ci`
- Align `expo` / `expo-build-properties` patch versions via `expo install --fix`
- Update Dependabot process docs and `/handle-dependabot` command
- Add `delivery.mdc` (ticketed branch + PR only; never push to main) and `rule-precedence.mdc` (ignore TangoGroup/Team Gloo umbrella rules)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm run doctor` passes locally and in Test Check CI on PRs
- [ ] Dependabot workflow docs require doctor after rebase / before merge
- [ ] Agent rules document no direct pushes to `main`
- [ ] All CI gates pass on the PR

## How to verify

1. `npm ci && npm run doctor`
2. `npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci`
3. Confirm Test Check workflow includes Expo Doctor step
